name: YHN Acquisition I Limited Unit
summary: YHN Acquisition I Limited currently does not engage in any substantial business activities. Its core mission is to execute a strategic business combination, which may take various forms such as a merger, an acquisition of shares or assets, a recapitalization, or a corporate reorganization, involving one or more other companies or ventures. The firm was established in 2023 and operates from its base in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
